The modifications in `core/lib/instrument.c` are primarily focused on improving code clarity and fixing a compile error that arose from the previous changes made in commit `3db7e90`. The changes ensure that variable names are consistent and that the code adheres to better practices by declaring variables closer to their usage. The update to the copyright year reflects the ongoing development and maintenance of the codebase. Overall, these changes contribute to resolving build issues while enhancing code readability.
